---
title: "Footer"
---

The `footer` block contains footnotes and source notes displayed below the table.

## Structure

```json
{
  "footer": {
    "footnotes": [...],
    "source_notes": [...]
  }
}
```

<!-- ir-fields: Footer -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `footnotes` | array of Footnote | `[]` | The footnotes, in order |
| `source_notes` | array of SourceNote | `[]` | The source notes, below the footnotes |

## Footnotes

Footnotes are referenced from cells via `footnote_mark` content nodes.

```json
{
  "footnotes": [
    {
      "id": "fn1",
      "mark": "1",
      "content": [{ "type": "text", "value": "Adjusted for inflation." }],
      "style_id": null
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- ir-fields: Footnote -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | required | The footnote's id, which `footnote_mark` nodes refer to (`ref`). Each footnote has its own (`DUPLICATE_ID` otherwise) |
| `mark` | string | required | The mark shown before the note (`"1"`, `"*"`, `"†"`) |
| `content` | array of [content nodes](index.qmd#content-nodes) | required | The note |
| `style_id` | string? | `null` | The note's style |

### Referencing from Cells

```json
{
  "content": [
    { "type": "text", "value": "Revenue" },
    { "type": "footnote_mark", "ref": "fn1", "mark_text": "1" }
  ]
}
```

## Source Notes

Source notes provide attribution for the entire table.

```json
{
  "source_notes": [
    {
      "content": [
        { "type": "text", "value": "Source: " },
        { "type": "styled_text", "value": "World Bank", "style_id": "italic" }
      ],
      "style_id": null
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- ir-fields: SourceNote -->

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `content` | array of [content nodes](index.qmd#content-nodes) | required | The note |
| `style_id` | string? | `null` | The note's style |
